visual_records.analytical_purpose: Expose the whole argument before model detail.
visual_records.exact_reading: Summary names PAM, two relation types, three event algorithms, budget, churn scenarios, no-external policy, multilayer network and sensitivity.
visual_records.next_action: Check every output against its upstream state and boundary.
visual_records.summary: Static graph to algorithms to policy route

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Fix the input unit and denominator.
visual_records.exact_reading: The source defines CR from resignations and start/end headcount.
visual_records.next_action: Release monthly counts and units.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make the reconstructed position hierarchy inspectable.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 1 lays out CEO, offices, directors, managers and branches with repeated blocks and vacancies concentrated at low level.
visual_records.next_action: Release a machine-readable roster and allocation.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Show directed organizational structure.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 2 uses node size/colour and a hierarchy layout to show formal position relations.
visual_records.next_action: Release all directed edges and layout policy.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate cooperation from formal reporting.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 3 shows green cooperation edges, red affiliation edges and example workers in a small office.
visual_records.next_action: Release weights, friendship source and graph snapshot.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Hand relation state to dynamics.
visual_records.exact_reading: The double sum combines affiliation intensity and friendship intensity; the PAM bullets identify fields refreshed by transfers and training.
visual_records.next_action: Define beta, ranges and refresh timing.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make training a state update rather than a narrative benefit.
visual_records.exact_reading: Two displayed recursions move efficiency toward an ideal and churn toward the 18% baseline using xi coefficients.
visual_records.next_action: Fit coefficients and report bounds.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Aggregate position state into a business proxy.
visual_records.exact_reading: The vector expression combines efficiency, base productivity and time with a fixed growth coefficient.
visual_records.next_action: Validate units and observed output.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make event priority explicit.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 4 traverses employees, records leaving tendency, sends high-middle cases to promotion/recruitment and refreshes the archive.
visual_records.next_action: Publish seeds, branch conditions and event order.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make promotion eligibility auditable.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 5 checks vacancies from high level down, ranks working time and tests maximum productivity against a higher-level initial value.
visual_records.next_action: Release threshold units and tie handling.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Read the baseline state before stressing churn.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 6 fluctuates around 85% for six months and settles near 80% over 100 months.
visual_records.next_action: Provide replications and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Explain random cost variation.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 7 shows ten volatile monthly cost traces and a high early transition.
visual_records.next_action: Release source costs, seeds and raw runs.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate structural cost shape from random arrivals.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 8 declines more smoothly as staffing and training demand change.
visual_records.next_action: Release worker-level cost inputs.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn same-axis scenarios into a staffing threshold check.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figures 9 and 10 cross below 80% by about months 12 and 4 and settle near 75% and 67%.
visual_records.next_action: Declare tolerance and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Read indirect morale effects beside staffing.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figures 11 and 12 fall rapidly from one and settle near 0.87 and 0.81.
visual_records.next_action: Validate enthusiasm against an observed measure.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate direct performance loss from enthusiasm and churn feedback.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figures 13 and 14 fluctuate before settling near 179 sigma and 153 sigma.
visual_records.next_action: Release raw series and cost units.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Expose the control-variate policy tradeoff.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 15 compares external middle-level recruitment with internal-only promotion; internal-only remains slightly higher.
visual_records.next_action: Compare delayed and capacity-constrained policies.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Prevent a staffing improvement from being read as a universal performance win.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 16 shows both curves declining and flattening with only a small internal-only increase.
visual_records.next_action: Use a matched outcome and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make the subgroup cost of internal-only promotion visible.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 17 is close for ten months, then external recruitment yields higher middle-level enthusiasm.
visual_records.next_action: Monitor subgroup morale and fairness.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Expose mobility versus stability tradeoff.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 18 rises more with external recruitment, which the source interprets as easier transfer and lower stability.
visual_records.next_action: Define change-time unit and policy objective.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make omitted everyday relations explicit.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 19 couples the same 14 workers across human-capital, friendship and competition layers.
visual_records.next_action: Collect observed layer edges before prediction.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn compact statistics into a data/team recommendation.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 1 compares average degree, clustering, path length and density; the multiplex row is richest and competition is densest.
visual_records.next_action: Test whether the recommendation changes outcomes.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Bound random simulation noise locally.
visual_records.exact_reading: The signed difference of two three-run groups is used to show maximum error below 0.015.
visual_records.next_action: Publish all six paths and an error tolerance.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: State a local sensitivity boundary.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 21 varies growth coefficients 1.02, 1.05, 1.07, 1.10 and 1.13 and reads little change above 1.07.
visual_records.next_action: Re-run the sweep with raw uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: End at the true evidence boundary.
visual_records.exact_reading: The final section claims PAM, dual relations and ordered algorithms, then admits omitted division operations and temporary/retired staff.
visual_records.next_action: Carry population and relation limits into reuse.
